choice: escape a leading backtick only when the line is a fence: three or more backticks and no backtick after them
why: escaping the first backtick of an inline code span unpairs it, so HTML inside the span (a comment, an image) renders as markup and the literal text disappears on GitHub

choice: replace main's block-quoted goal (_contained) with the escaping writer; keep #554's 26 goal cases as tests
why: one writer covers Goal, Risk and Done-evidence; #554 quoted only the goal, and every #554 case still passes against the escaping writer

choice: join a line that starts inside an open inline code span onto the previous line with one space; escape only lines that start outside a span
why: CommonMark renders a line ending inside a code span as a space and strips a continuation line's leading whitespace, so the rendering is unchanged, and no span content ever sits at a line start where an escape or a block opener could touch it
